text:
Maya: Heads-up - nightly e2e perf gate tripped on canary. p95 longseq jumped ~40% vs baseline. Heatmap attached. Can someone triage? CI id: nightly-2042-e2e-2317. /cc @sam @kevin :eyes:

Sam: On it. Are you seeing this across regions or just us-east? link to heatmap: https://ci.internal/heatmaps/2317

Maya: Only us-east for now. Canary vs baseline diff: p95 180ms -> 250ms. throughput stable. logs mention more retries in runner.

perfbot: [automated] job nightly-2042-e2e-2317 failed perf gate. commit: a3c9f7e. Baseline commit: 9b2d4f1. Attached summary: p95: +70ms, p99: +120ms. Investigation tags: kvcache, batching

Kevin: I can bisect if someone kicks a rerun with --collect-heatmap. Also want the exact git range. @maya can you add the commit range? 

Maya: Range is 9b2d4f1..a3c9f7e (includes PR #4222). That PR touched kvcache invalidation and small batching tweak.

Olivia: PR 4222 landed last night. I suspect the kvcache TTL change. Quick check: can we rerun without that change? @sam can you spawn a run that pins old commit for the runtime? 

Sam: Starting a canary rerun now with commit 9b2d4f1 and with --warmup-iter=200. CI link: https://ci.internal/runs/98765

Jin: If it's kvcache, metric I'd expect: cold-starts per shard up, KV lookup latencies spike. Can you paste the small trace where we log "kvcache miss" counts? 

Maya: Paste from logs:
```
[2026-04-12T02:15:10Z] kvcache: miss shard=3 key=0x7f... count=32
[2026-04-12T02:15:11Z] kvcache: miss shard=1 key=0x2a... count=28
```

Sam: Rerun results: pinned commit show p95 back to baseline (185ms). The canary with PR shows 252ms. So PR correlates. I'll start bisect across PRs in the range.

Kevin: Thanks. If bisect reproduces, we should fast-revert or roll-forward with a patch to TTL. Who volunteers for a quick patch? :hand: 

Olivia: I'll draft a revert PR and include tests for kvcache TTL behavior. Will ping for review.

Maya: Great. For tracking, opening an issue: https://phabricator/infer/ISSUE-1282 with logs + heatmap. I'll update once revert PR is up.

Sam: Reassigning owner to olivia. Adding label perf-regression.

perfbot: [automated] bisect job queued by kevin - job id 7684.

Kevin: I'll watch bisect and report findings. If it's a config flag, maybe we can toggle as hotfix.

Maya: Thanks all. Quick note: keep an eye on canary for the next 2 runs, don't promote until perf gate stable. :eyes:
